tools.name: customize_theme
tools.description: Used to setup a custom theme for your Chakra UI. You can define new tokens or modify existing ones.

category.description: The category of the token to customize

tools.name: get_component_example
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive example code and usage patterns for a specific Chakra UI component. This tool provides practical implementation examples including basic usage, advanced configurations, and common use cases with complete code snippets.

component.description: The name of the Chakra UI component to get example code for

tools.name: get_component_props
tools.description: Get detailed properties of a specific Chakra UI component. This tool retrieves the properties, attributes, design related props for a component, like size, variant, etc. and configuration options available for a given Chakra UI component.

component.description: The name of the Chakra UI component to get properties for

tools.name: get_component_templates
tools.description: Retrieve well designed, fully responsive, and accessible component templates.

category.description: The name of the block category to retrieve from Chakra UI pro

id.description: The ID of the block variant to retrieve from Chakra UI pro

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Retrieve the theme specification (colors, fonts, textStyles, etc.) to design any page, component or section

tools.name: list_component_templates
tools.description: List available component templates or blocks in the Chakra UI pro. This tool retrieves the names of all available component templates in the Chakra UI pro, which can be used to enhance the design and functionality of your application.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List all available components in Chakra UI. This tool retrieves the names of all available Chakra UI components.

tools.name: v2_to_v3_code_review
tools.description: ALWAYS use this tool to review any generated code. This tool helps you get familiar with the new Chakra UI v3 API before/after code snippets for common migration scenarios to help avoid AI hallucination.

scenario.description: The migration scenario to get guidance for
